constraints: Native Windows only. Requires fresh active editable snapshot and up-to-date all_source. Unchanged scratch control ELF must reproduce production byte-for-byte before the source-substitution trial. No production source/config/link output edits.

PASS means the experiment completed, not successful trial linkage or boot. Truncated diagnostics are lower bounds; retained autogenerated data/BSS means this is not asset reconstruction or a claim of complete source coverage.
Refuses changed ordered inventories or unsafe output paths. Optional --max-errors 1000 is diagnostic only and may still hit the native linker hard cap.
name: r67-runtime-allsource-probe
purpose: Bounded actual-link experiment comparing editable configured-matching source linkage with all configured source objects, preserving automatic data and production outputs.
usage: After configure.py --non-matching, ninja, and ninja all_source: python tools/gdl/composed_census/r67_runtime_allsource_probe.py --out build/r67_runtime_allsource.json
